title: Value Line Semi-Automatic Hydraulic Band Saws — NT-H 10 F & NT-H series | NovoTech Canada
meta_description: NovoTech value-line semi-automatic band saws in Canada: NT-H 10 S/10 T hydraulic pivot saws, NT-H 13 twin-mitre, NT-H 16, NT-H 12 SC single-column with touch screen and the 18″ NT-H 18. Specs in inches and mm.
intro: Hydraulic saws for the production floor at value-line prices, led by our best seller — the NT-H 10 F, a 10-inch twin-mitre saw with hydraulic vise, hydraulic down-feed and hydraulic bow up-lift. A hydraulic cylinder lowers the bow at a dialled-in rate, the bow lifts and the machine stops at the end of the cut. From the 10-inch saws to the 18-inch NT-H 18 swivel-head saw, with a single-column touch-screen model (NT-H 12 SC) in between.

faq_title: Questions we get asked about NovoTech semi-automatic band saws

faq.q: What is the difference between a semi-automatic and a fully automatic band saw?
faq.a: A semi-automatic saw makes one cut per start: it clamps, cuts and lifts the bow, then waits for the operator to feed the next piece. A fully automatic saw also feeds the material to length and repeats the cycle for the programmed quantity — see the value line automatic band saws.

faq.q: Which value-line saws cut miters on both sides?
faq.a: The NT-H 10 F, NT-H 10 T, NT-H 13 / 13 C and NT-H 18 swivel to both sides (45° left and right, 60° right). The NT-H 10 S swivels to one side (45°–90°) and the NT-H 16 cuts angles up to 60° on one side.

faq.q: What makes the NT-H 10 F different from the NT-H 10 S?
faq.a: The NT-H 10 F is the full-hydraulic machine: hydraulic vise, hydraulic down-feed and hydraulic bow up-lift, a gear drive and a bow that swivels to both sides with fast stops at 30°, 45° and 60°. The NT-H 10 S is the belt-driven saw with a hydraulic vise and a bow that swivels to one side.

Single column: the NT-H 12 SC guides the bow vertically on a column instead of a pivot, for square straight cuts up to Ø11-3/4″ / 19-3/4″ × 11-3/4″ with a PLC touch screen. Its automatic sister is the NT-A 12 SC.

faq.q: What voltage do these saws run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V with a CSA-approved electrical panel; 208 V, 240 V or 480 V 3-phase are available on request.
